answer: Agents bond stake and evaluate an epoch-specific polynomial to derive RLN shares and nullifiers tied to their Semaphore identity. If an agent sends duplicate messages within one rate limit—whether on orchard, jetty, or mesa—the proofs reveal distinct shares; interpolation recovers the private key. The evidence is publicly verifiable and triggers immediate collateral slashing, making extra messaging costly and Sybil identities accountable to bonded stake.
